newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S FOREX FUTURES FOCUS ON MARK DEALS.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S FOREX FUTURES FOCUS ON MARK DEALS.

text.p: Currency futures trading on both Hungarian bourses focused on the German mark on Thursday.
Ther mark accounted for almost half of the Budapest Commodity Exchange's 23,198 lot, or 3.63 billion forint, currency futures turnover.
Most mark deals were made for the March 1998 maturity.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, mark deals accounted for four-fifth of the total currency futures turnover of about 2.6 billion forints.
The most popular maturity was December, for which the mark firmed 54 fillers to 114.84 forints.
